name: 02719 · Fairhaven, MA
findings: ZIP 02719 (Fairhaven) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02719 (Fairhaven) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02719 (Fairhaven) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
